title: Momoi Airi — Many Feelings Delivered〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'll reply to this person's offer before the end of the day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, we're really gonna be on TV...!
We need to tell all of our stream viewers about this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we do. We'll probably be meeting with people from the show, so we also need to ask them about how and when we can advertise our appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing how our fans are going to react.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're not gonna be able to contain themselves! I mean, I'm having trouble already!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's going to be your very first TV appearance, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you should start mentally preparing yourself for it as soon as you can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Don't worry, I'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh? Someone feels confident.
In that case, why don't we leave all the talking to you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! I didn't mean it like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku, Airi & Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Actually...
Is there anything we can do right now to start preparing for it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well, a few things come to mind...
For example, writing down stories.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! You'll never get stuck for words as long as you have some stories about you or someone you know, including hearsay and gossip, jotted down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me of Airi's little notepad. She'd been writing down stories and such in it for quite a long time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I sort of couldn't believe what I saw when she showed me what she'd written. It looked like a dictionary.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I kept running out of things to talk about when I was still doing variety shows. So, I constantly searched for juicy scoops.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Researching who you're going to be appearing with is also important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that's incredibly important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: New celebrities in particular tend to only appear alongside their seniors, so it's good to look up when they debuted, what they do and such...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's always nice to hear from others that they know who you are and what you do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's also important for developing a good relationship with someone. After all, it's hard to tell how long you'll be working with them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we still don't know about the other guests we'll be appearing alongside yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. They even said that they've invited some guests who've been making headlines lately! How great would it be if we got to know each other really well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may depend on which agency they belong to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Why?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sadly, a lot of reasons.
Some agencies want to prevent their respective groups from creating conflict with each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some groups are famous for being cool or mysterious, so they'll try to stay in character even when the cameras aren't rolling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know about any of these unspoken rules. I'm starting to get a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. We'll make sure to teach everything that we think you should know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. So, Minori, you can leave all of that to us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna give you all the advice we can so that people won't forget who you are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, maybe that's going a bit too far...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I sort of can't help it since it's always how I pumped myself up for variety show appearances.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I think we need to have that sort of motivation. I mean, MORE MORE JUMP! is appearing on TV for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also don't have much experience appearing on variety shows, so I might ask you for some more advice, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Then, I guess I have no choice but to give you all a little seminar about my experiences.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. But above all else, our goal is to have everyone see what MORE MORE JUMP! is really about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We'll need to be mindful about that when we go meet with the show staff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. After all, this appearance will likely greatly affect how the public views us moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I still don't know how I'm gonna be able to help us, but I promise to try my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit, Minori!
Honestly, you can only plan for so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's time to practice!
Let's get started with some stretches!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yes!
